name: Nebius Lappeenranta AI Factory / Pajarila Data Center
notes: City of Lappeenranta and Nebius state that Nebius is building a multibuilding AI data center campus in Pajarila, Lappeenranta; Nebius gives full capacity as 310 MW, with first phase expected in 2027.

name: Pure DC SJK01 Seinäjoki Campus
notes: Pure DC describes Seinäjoki SJK01 as its largest campus project, scalable beyond 550 MW on 370 acres, with phase 1 underway and 110 MW leased; trade press reports Microsoft capacity and the city land purchase.

name: Isojoki / Pettenkangas Data Center Project
notes: Trade press citing local reports says Isojoki municipality is selling about 180 hectares near Pettenkangas industrial area for a planned data center; construction could start in September 2026, but capacity was not disclosed.

name: Compute Nordic Visulahti Data Center Campus
notes: Mikkeli Development Miksei reports Compute Nordic is preparing a 200 MW data center campus in Visulahti, with phased construction planned toward 2028 and about 10 hectares secured plus expansion options.

name: Regant Oy Visulahti Data Center
notes: Mikkeli/Miksei says the city will lease Regant a five-hectare plot in Visulahti with more than 24,000 sqm of building rights for a planned large-scale data center; final scope remains under design.

name: Aurora Core Technology Pellos AI Data Center
developer: Aurora Core Technology Oy; 3 E Network Technology Group
notes: Mikkeli Development Miksei says Aurora Core Technology signed a land lease for a 10-hectare Pellos industrial site; initial 6 MW phase is expected in H2 2026, with up to 50 MW grid connection capacity possible over time.

name: Orka Technologies EcoSairila Data Center
notes: Miksei reports Orka Technologies confirmed an investment decision for a first 5 MW phase under an existing construction permit in EcoSairila; construction scheduled for Q1 2026 and initial go-live for Q3 2026.

name: XTX Markets Kajaani Data Center Campus
notes: Invest in Kainuu and DCD report XTX Markets is investing over EUR 1bn on a 478-acre Kajaani campus; the first data center totals three data halls and 22.5 MW IT power, with completion/operation targeted in 2026.

name: CSC Kajaani Data Center / LUMI AI Factory Expansion
notes: CSC says its Kajaani data center is expanding to host LUMI-AI and LUMI-IQ systems, with completion expected in 2027; SRV states it is responsible for construction of the LUMI AI Factory data center and expects operation in spring 2027.

name: Google Kajaani Land / Potential Data Center Campus
notes: Yle reports Google is planning data centers in Kajaani, Vaala and Muhos; DatacenterMap reports Google acquired land in Kajaani and Muhos for potential data centers. No capacity or firm construction schedule found.

name: Kuhmo Data Center Feasibility Project
notes: Yle reports Kuhmo reserved a study phase with a Norwegian property developer for a potential data center requiring an estimated 40 MW or more; investor and final feasibility were still open.

name: QTS Forssa Data Center Campus
notes: QTS official site describes its first Finland data center campus on a 150-hectare site in Forssa; Roschier says it advised Blackstone and QTS on the ongoing large-scale Forssa development.

name: Hämeenlinna MORE Industrial Park Data Center Campus
notes: Trade press says Hämeenlinna made a plot reservation agreement for three MORE Industrial Park plots totaling 149,795 sqm, enabling a data center of up to 120 MW while the developer seeks an experienced operator.

name: Fortum / City of Jyväskylä Seppälänkangas Data Center Complex
notes: Fortum and Jyväskylä signed a letter of intent to develop and market a data center complex of at least 20 hectares in the Seppälänkangas area; operator and capacity were not disclosed.

name: Google Hamina Data Center
notes: Google official location page says it opened Hamina in 2011 after purchasing the Summa paper mill in 2009, with a seventh data center announced in 2024 and EUR 3.5bn invested to date; capacity not disclosed.

name: Hyperco / TikTok Kouvola-Koria Data Center
notes: TikTok says Hyperco is building a Kouvola data center for Project Clover under a EUR 1bn investment, and later announced construction had begun; DCD/Yle report the initial IT capacity as about 100 MW.

name: Hyperco Koria Second Data Center
notes: Trade press reports Hyperco received permission for a second Koria data center building of about 56,670 sqm, approximately 100 MW IT capacity and 130 MW total electrical capacity.

name: DayOne Kouvola Campus
notes: DayOne official Finland page says its Finland platform totals 281 MW across Lahti and Kouvola; since Lahti is separately described by DCD as 128 MW, the implied Kouvola component is about 153 MW. Capacity is inferred from public statements.

name: FCDC Rovaniemi / Hietavaara Data Center
notes: Trade press citing city/local reports says FCDC Corp Oy plans a 500 MW data center at Hietavaara near Rovaniemi, with 180,000 sqm building rights, construction targeted for 2027 and operations around 2029.

name: Polarnode Keminmaa Data Center Project
notes: Polarnode lists a Keminmaa data center project in the Sea Lapland region, citing network capacity and strategic location; no public capacity or timeline was found on the project page.
